completed_directory.description: Directory where completed downloads are moved

download_directory.description: Directory where active downloads are stored

max_downloads.description: Maximum number of simultaneous downloads (0 = unlimited)

max_upload_rate.description: Maximum total upload bandwidth in KB/s (0 = unlimited)

max_download_rate.description: Maximum total download bandwidth in KB/s (0 = unlimited)

max_peers_per_torrent.description: Maximum number of peers per torrent

enable_upnp.description: Enable UPnP port mapping for automatic router configuration

enable_natpmp.description: Enable NAT-PMP port mapping for automatic router configuration

listen_port.description: TCP/UDP port for incoming BitTorrent connections

http_host.description: Hostname or IP to bind HTTP server (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces)

http_username.description: Username for HTTP authentication (leave empty to disable auth)

enable_https.description: Enable HTTPS for web UI (requires certificate and key)

tls_cert.description: Path to TLS certificate file (required for HTTPS)

tls_key.description: Path to TLS private key file (required for HTTPS)

enable_logging.description: Enable logging of events and diagnostics

log_max_size_mb.description: Maximum size (MB) per log file before rotation (0 = disable)

log_backup_count.description: Number of old log files to retain

urls.description: Default public trackers to announce to (if torrent lacks trackers)

enable_dht.description: Enable DHT for peer discovery without trackers

enable_pex.description: Enable Peer Exchange (PEX) with connected peers

per_torrent_upload_limit.description: Per-torrent upload limit in KB/s (0 = use global max)

per_torrent_download_limit.description: Per-torrent download limit in KB/s (0 = unlimited)

seed_ratio.description: Upload ratio target (e.g., 1.0 = upload same volume as downloaded); 0 disables seeding

seed_time.description: Seed time target in minutes (0 = disabled)
